about.title: About me
about.bio: I'm Enrique Such Andreu, a Digital Technology and Multimedia student at UPV with a Master's in Artificial Intelligence from the University of Bologna (Erasmus). I move between technical and creative worlds: programming, computer vision, 3D animation, virtual reality, and web design. I look for projects that combine technology and user experience in innovative ways.
